title: Portrait Gallery
text: The painter sets up his easel in the long gallery, where the House's dead look down in oils. One of the House refuses to sit. The painter only smiles. It does not matter, he says; he has painted them before, long ago, and he turns a canvas around to show them.

outcomes.text: The portrait shows something the sitter did not mean to show, standing just behind them.
The painter leaves in the night. The portrait's eyes are scratched out from the inside of the canvas.
The painter paints the hound instead. The hound will not go into the gallery again.
